phase_0_schema.details: Added article_perspectives table with RLS policies (SELECT published for all, full access for admin). Added prompt_hash index on articles. Updated Database types with ArticlePerspective.

phase_1_claude_api.details: POST endpoint with Zod validation, Claude Sonnet API integration, p-limit(2) rate limiting, 30s/60s/120s exponential backoff on 429, SHA-256 prompt_hash dedup, admin auth (service_role or JWT), inserts to articles + article_perspectives.

phase_2_admin_approval.details: Server Component page with admin role check, client dashboard with stats cards, draft article queue, batch approve with checkboxes, individual preview modal with sentiment bar and perspectives.

phase_3_manual_submit.details: URL input form, auto metadata extraction from known media hostnames, calls /api/articles/generate, genre/sub_genre selection, admin role guard.

phase_4_n8n_workflow.details: 15-minute cron trigger, 9 media RSS feeds (sports/economy/gaming), robots.txt check, RSS parsing, politics keyword filter, URL hash + content hash dedup, genre grouping, POST to /api/articles/generate.

quality_checks.admin_auth: getUser() + profile role check on all admin routes
